extracted.intended_audience: new and prospective Public Information Officers; emergency managers at state, local, tribal, territorial, and Federal agencies; executives needing PIO role awareness
extracted.subtask_description: Awareness- and beginning-level training for Public Information Officers (PIOs) covering the concepts, skills, delivery modes, prerequisites, and time commitments required to perform as PIOs in both routine/proactive and crisis/emergency response contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Information Awareness and Basics
rubrics_metrics.description: Awareness of the concepts underlying the PIO role, and a basic understanding of the PIO function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The PIO awareness courses are designed to introduce new emergency managers ... to the concepts underlying the PIO role. They also build a foundational knowledge of the skills needed to be full or part-time PIOs, including oral and written communications; understanding and working with the media; and basic tools and techniques to perform effectively as a PIO, both in the proactive/advocacy times and crisis/emergency response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oral communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Skills in oral communications necessary for PIO duties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E0105 is designed to equip participants with the skills needed to be full or part-time PIOs, including oral ... communications; (applicable in proactive/advocacy and crisis/emergency response).

rubrics_metrics.name: Written communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Skills in written communications necessary for PIO duties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E0105 emphasizes written communications as a core skill for effective PIO performance in both proactive and emergency contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understanding and working with the media
rubrics_metrics.description: Knowledge and practical ability to interact with media organizations and journalists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course coverage includes understanding and working with the media as a fundamental PIO responsibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic tools and techniques for PIO performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Familiarity with basic tools and techniques PIOs use to perform effectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes techniques and tools applicable to proactive/advocacy times and crisis/emergency response; taught in the E0105 classroom course.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability across operational contexts
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to perform PIO duties during both proactive/advocacy periods and crisis/emergency response.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The curriculum explicitly prepares participants to function as PIOs 'both in the proactive/ advocacy times and crisis/ emergency response.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Intended audience / target learners
rubrics_metrics.description: Course is intended for new emergency managers from State, local, tribal, territorial, and Federal emergency management agencies and executives who need knowledge of PIO roles during an emergency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Public Information Officer Awareness Courses are designed to introduce new emergency managers ... They can also provide those in executive level roles the necessary knowledge of PIO roles and responsibilities during an emergency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prerequisites for IS-29
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommended prior training before taking IS-29.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The participant will benefit from participating in entry-level incident command system training prior to taking this course.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prerequisites for E0105
rubrics_metrics.description: Required prior course to enroll in E0105.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IS-29: Public Information Officer Awareness is a prerequisite for E0105: Public Information Basics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course delivery / modality
rubrics_metrics.description: The mode(s) in which the course is offered (independent study vs classroom variants).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IS-29 is an Independent Study (complete independently). E0105 is Classroom Delivery with Resident (E), Local (L), Virtual (K) options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course length / time commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: The expected duration or student time commitment for each course.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IS-29 Course Length: 7 hours. E0105 Course Length: 3 days (24 hours).

rubrics_metrics.name: Integration with National Emergency Management Basic Academy (NEMBA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Relationship of these courses to the broader NEMBA curriculum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both of the PIO awareness courses also comprise a portion of the National Emergency Management Basic Academy (NEMBA) curriculum.
